title: HubEventEnvelope
description: Shared envelope of every outbound callback (Hub -> tenant registrar endpoint, DESIGN §12.1). The body is signed: `X-Hub-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex hmac-sha256(secret, t + "." + raw_body)>`. Receivers MUST verify the signature over the raw bytes, reject timestamps older than 5 minutes, and de-duplicate on `event_id` (delivery is at-least-once). Never carries vendor names, account names or versions.

event_id.description: Unique event id (`evt_` + ULID). Stable across delivery retries of the same event; use it to de-duplicate.

type.description: Event type. Also sent as the `X-Hub-Event` header.

spec_version.description: Envelope major version. Additive changes keep "1".

occurred_at.description: When the state change happened (RFC 3339, UTC).

tenant_id.description: The tenant that made the request (the receiver's own tenant).

integration_id.description: Integration id the request was invoked on.

idempotency_key.description: The caller's Idempotency-Key, or null if none was sent.

data.description: Event-specific payload; see the per-type schema.
